tools.name: kanna_list_repos
tools.description: List repositories known to the running Kanna desktop server, including each repo's id, name, and local path.

tools.name: kanna_add_repo
tools.description: Register an existing local git repository with Kanna.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the local git repository to register.

params.name: name
params.description: Display name for the repository. Defaults to the directory name.

tools.name: kanna_list_recent_tasks
tools.description: List recent open Kanna tasks across all repositories, newest first.

tools.name: kanna_get_task
tools.description: Fetch one Kanna task's detail: stage, activity, branch, worktree path, blockers, latest stage-run result (latestRun), and the revision-round budget (revisionRounds, revisionLimit).

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_wait_task
tools.description: Block until a Kanna task finishes (agent stopped, activity 'unread') or closes, polling its detail. Returns the task detail plus waitOutcome 'resolved'. If the wait window elapses first it returns the latest detail with waitOutcome 'timeout' instead of failing — that is a normal result, so call it again in a loop to keep waiting.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: timeout_secs
params.description: Seconds to wait before returning the latest detail with waitOutcome 'timeout' (clamped to at most 240, so the call returns inside the 300s tools/call timeout MCP clients enforce).

params.name: poll_secs
params.description: Seconds between polls (minimum 1).

params.name: until
params.description: 'finished' resolves when the task's agent stops or the task closes; 'closed' resolves only when the task closes.

tools.name: kanna_wait_events
tools.description: Watch several Kanna tasks at once: blocks until any of them emits an event, then returns every event since your cursor plus a new cursor. This is the tool for orchestrating child tasks — kanna_wait_task blocks on one id and resolves only on finish, so it cannot watch a fan-out. Event types: 'task.created', 'run.started', 'run.finished' (payload.status succeeded/failed/cancelled, payload.result), 'stage.changed', 'task.pr_created', 'task.revision_requested' (payload.exhausted true means the task is parked for its human — stop waiting), 'task.closed', and 'task.awaiting_input' (the agent is parked on an interactive prompt and needs an answer, e.g. via kanna_send_task_input). Call it in a loop, passing back the cursor you were given: events that fire between two calls are delivered on the next one, each exactly once. Omit the cursor on the first call to receive the scope's retained history. An elapsed window returns waitOutcome 'timeout' with no events and a fresh cursor — a normal result, not an error. hasMore true means another batch is already waiting, so call again immediately.

params.name: task_ids
params.description: Task ids (or branch names) to watch, e.g. the child tasks you created. Required unless repo_id is given.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Watch every task in this repository instead of naming ids. Ignored when task_ids is given.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor returned by the previous call. Omit on the first call to receive the retained history for the scope.

params.name: timeout_secs
params.description: Seconds to block before returning waitOutcome 'timeout' with no events (clamped to at most 240, so the call returns inside the 300s tools/call timeout MCP clients enforce).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum events in one response (1-500, default 100). When more are pending the response sets hasMore.

tools.name: kanna_set_task_notify
tools.description: Set or clear the task that is notified when this task finishes: that task's terminal receives 'TASK <id> DONE [success|failure|closed]: <title>' as input. The status is one of exactly three words: success (ended cleanly), failure (its terminating run reported failure, or its agent process died), closed (closed before finishing its pipeline — not a failure). Unlike the creation-time notify_task_id this works on an already-running task, so an orchestrator can adopt tasks it did not create. Omit notify_task_id to stop notifying. For watching many tasks at once, prefer kanna_wait_events.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}) whose completion should be announced.

params.name: notify_task_id
params.description: Task id that receives the completion message. Omit to clear the notification target.

tools.name: kanna_task_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent agent-session log lines for a Kanna task, oldest first.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: tail
params.description: Maximum number of most-recent log lines to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: kanna_search_tasks
tools.description: Search open Kanna tasks by case-insensitive substring match against display name and prompt.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched (case-insensitive) against task display names and prompts.

tools.name: kanna_list_repo_tasks
tools.description: List Kanna tasks for a repository.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos.

tools.name: kanna_list_agents
tools.description: List every resolved named agent definition available to task creation for a repository. Each result includes the invokable name, resolved frontmatter description, definition default provider and model, and source (built_in, repo_override, or repo_authored). A null defaultProvider means task creation falls back to the configured user default. Repo AGENT.md files win over built-ins by name, and repo EXTEND.md files are already layered into the reported defaults.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos.

tools.name: kanna_create_task
tools.description: Create a new Kanna task: forks a worktree and starts the pipeline's first stage agent with the prompt. When called from a Kanna task session, repo_id defaults to the current task's repo. `agent` optionally names any resolved agent definition returned by kanna_list_agents to run the task's first stage with, overriding the pipeline stage's own agent binding.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos. Optional inside a Kanna task session, where it defaults to the current task's repo.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Task prompt given to the first stage's agent.

params.name: display_name
params.description: Short human-readable task title shown in the sidebar. Omitting it does not derive a title: the task falls back to the prompt text itself, clipped to fit, so tasks whose prompts share an opening line become indistinguishable. Always pass one when creating several tasks from a template.

params.name: pipeline_name
params.description: Pipeline to run (e.g. 'no-review', 'single-reviewer', 'specialty-review'). Defaults to the repo's configured pipeline.

params.name: agent
params.description: Any resolved agent definition name returned by kanna_list_agents. It runs the first stage instead of the stage's own agent binding; repo overrides and EXTEND.md layering are honored.

params.name: base_ref
params.description: Git ref to fork the task's branch and worktree from. Defaults to the repo's default branch.

params.name: agent_provider
params.description: Explicit agent provider id: 'claude', 'copilot', 'codex', 'opencode', or 'antigravity'. When omitted, Kanna uses the selected stage or agent definition's provider candidates, then the configured user default.

params.name: agent_type
params.description: 'pty' runs the agent CLI in an interactive terminal session; 'agent' runs it headless via the SDK.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id passed verbatim to the selected agent CLI: Claude uses '--model <id>', Copilot uses '--model=<id>', and Codex/OpenCode use '-m <id>'; Antigravity rejects model overrides. An explicit value overrides agent-definition frontmatter; omit it to use the provider default. Kanna does not maintain a model-id allowlist.

params.name: permission_mode
params.description: Permission mode passed to the agent CLI, in camelCase: 'dontAsk', 'acceptEdits', or 'default'.

params.name: parent_task_id
params.description: Existing task id to nest this task under as a subtask in the sidebar.

params.name: notify_task_id
params.description: Task id to notify when this task finishes: that task's terminal receives 'TASK <id> DONE [success|failure|closed]: <title>' as input. The status is one of exactly three words: success (ended cleanly), failure (its terminating run reported failure, or its agent process died), closed (closed before finishing its pipeline — not a failure).

params.name: allowed_tools
params.description: Allow-listed tool names passed to the agent CLI.

params.name: blocker_task_ids
params.description: Task ids that must finish before this task; it shows as blocked until they do.

tools.name: kanna_signal_agent
tools.description: Find or create a singleton task for an agent in a repo and send it a message.

params.name: repo_id
params.description: Repository id from kanna_list_repos.

params.name: agent
params.description: Agent definition name to signal (e.g. 'merge-master').

params.name: message
params.description: Message delivered to the agent's terminal session as input.

tools.name: kanna_send_task_input
tools.description: Send input text to a running Kanna task's agent terminal session; a trailing Enter is added when needed so the agent submits it.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: input
params.description: Text to type into the task's agent terminal.

tools.name: kanna_close_task
tools.description: Close a Kanna task: kills its agent and shell sessions, snapshots dirty worktree state into local WIP commits, and removes its worktrees. Branches are kept. The task disappears from the sidebar.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_rename_task
tools.description: Rename an existing Kanna task by setting its display name.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: display_name
params.description: New short human-readable task title shown in the sidebar.

tools.name: kanna_advance_stage
tools.description: Advance a Kanna task to the next pipeline stage. If the current stage declares a post, the post prompt runs in the current agent session first and its success triggers the transition. A transition forks a fresh branch and worktree from the committed tip and starts the next stage's agent there; the task id stays the same. Advancing past the final stage closes the task.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_rerun_stage
tools.description: Rerun the current pipeline stage for a Kanna task in place: cancels the running stage run and starts a fresh agent session for the same stage in the same worktree.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_block_task
tools.description: Mark a Kanna task as blocked by one or more tasks. Blocked tasks show in the sidebar's blocked section until their blockers finish.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: blocker_task_ids
params.description: Task ids that must finish before the blocked task.

tools.name: kanna_unblock_task
tools.description: Remove all blockers from a Kanna task.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_set_task_parent
tools.description: Set or clear a Kanna task's parent task so it nests as a subtask in the sidebar. Omit parent_task_id to detach the task from its parent.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: parent_task_id
params.description: Task id to nest this task under. Omit to detach the task from its current parent.

tools.name: kanna_is_dependent_tasks_exist
tools.description: Check whether open Kanna tasks still depend on a task's branch before deleting its remote branch.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

tools.name: kanna_complete_stage
tools.description: Record pipeline stage completion for the current stage run; success can trigger configured auto-advance, while failure stops advancement and surfaces the summary to the user.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: status
params.description: 'success' records the stage as complete and can trigger configured auto-advance; 'failure' records what blocked the stage and stops advancement.

params.name: summary
params.description: Short summary of what was accomplished, or on failure, what is blocking.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional structured result data (e.g. a review verdict) stored on the stage run and readable from the task detail's latestRun.

tools.name: kanna_request_revision
tools.description: Request a revision on a Kanna task: resumes the target stage's previous agent session in its worktree when possible (Claude, with context intact), otherwise starts a fresh agent in a newly forked workspace. Kanna delivers the original task prompt alongside the revision prompt, so the prompt should focus on the required changes. Agent-requested revisions are budgeted per task: the response's revisionBudget reports rounds/limit, and once the budget is spent the request starts nothing and the task parks for its human (revisionBudget.exhausted) — report your findings and stop instead of retrying.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task id (stable across stages) or one of the task's branch names (task-{id} or task-{id}-{n}).

params.name: target_stage
params.description: Pipeline stage whose agent should make the changes.

params.name: summary
params.description: Short summary of why the revision is needed, shown to the user.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Instructions for the revising agent. Kanna delivers the original task prompt alongside this, so describe only the required changes.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Optional structured data (e.g. review findings) stored on the revision request.
